stories.title: Kura Oncology Beats on Earnings, Falls Short on Revenue
stories.summary: Kura Oncology reported quarterly earnings per share that beat analyst estimates by $0.03. Revenue came in below Wall Street forecasts, Investing.com reported.
stories.whyItMatters: A profit beat paired with a revenue miss points to cost control, not stronger demand, for a biotech investors watch closely.
whatToWatch: Management commentary on the revenue shortfall
questions: Did the company change its outlook?
